literal_meaning: এঁড়েকে তেল দেওয়া (applying oil to a donkey)
figurative_meaning_en: To satisfy or appease someone with flattering or sweet words
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এঁড়ে তেল দিয়ে বস্তুমালিককে রাজি করালো।
মা এঁড়ে তেল দিয়ে ছেলেকে শান্ত করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He buttered up the shopkeeper to get a discount.
She sweet-talked her son to calm him down.
history: This idiom draws from rural Bengali life where donkeys are common pack animals, and 'oiling' metaphorically suggests insincere lubrication to manipulate, often in bargaining or domestic situations.
note: Marked as অশালীন (vulgar) due to crude imagery; used colloquially but avoided in polite speech.
